title: Get Segments Response
description: Response payload for get_segments task. Returns matching segments and optional curator-suggested deal proposals.

proposals.description: Optional curator-suggested deal packages with segment allocations. Proposals are actionable — buyers can refine them via follow-up get_segments calls, or execute them directly via create_deal with proposal_id.

description.description: Explanation of why this package is recommended

allocation_pct.description: Percentage of total budget allocated to this segment (0-100)

suggested_budget.description: Curator's recommended total budget for this proposal

suggested_platform.description: Recommended SSP platform ID for this proposal

deal_type.description: Recommended deal type for this proposal

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for this proposal. After this time, the proposal may no longer be valid for create_deal.

refinement_applied.description: Curator's response to each change request in the refine array, matched by position. Only present when the request used buying_mode: 'refine'.

scope.description: Echoes the scope from the corresponding refine entry.

id.description: Echoes the id from the corresponding refine entry (for segment scope).

status.description: 'applied': the ask was fulfilled. 'partial': partially fulfilled — see notes. 'unable': could not fulfill — see notes.

notes.description: Curator explanation of what was done, what couldn't be done, or why.

sandbox.description: When true, this response contains simulated data from sandbox mode.
